title: The Insane Story Behind the Hypercar Holy Trinity
description:
Three cars, three companies, and one year. In twenty thirteen Ferrari, McLaren and Porsche each showed a hybrid hypercar, and the world gave them a single nickname: the Holy Trinity. But nobody, in the sources we found, says who named it, or whether any of the three companies was racing the others. This is the story as the record actually tells it, with the dates, the numbers, and the gaps. We read Wikipedia's pages on all three cars, evo, Top Gear magazine's history of the nickname, Carwow, and a fan-maintained wiki for the Grand Tour episode. We name each source, we flag the ones that are only community or marketing material, and where two sources disagree we show both. Our own arithmetic is always labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

15:27 What came after
